clauses.requirement: For ESA testing under Annex 9 para 4.3.2.1 (including ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" using the substitution method), unless otherwise specified, the ESA case shall be connected to the ground plane either directly or via a defined impedance.

For ESA testing under Annex 9 para 4.3.2.1, unless otherwise specified, the test shall be performed with the injection probe placed around each of the following harnesses: (a) low voltage harness; (b) high voltage harness; (c) AC power lines, if applicable; (d) DC power lines, if applicable.
Where stripline testing is used as a specific ESA test method under Annex 9 para 4, it shall be carried out in accordance with the requirements of para 4.4 (test method and test methodology).
The stripline test method shall subject the wiring harness connecting the components in an ESA to specified field strengths.
The stripline test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
Where the reverberation chamber test is used as a specific ESA test method under Annex 9 para 4, it shall be carried out in accordance with para 4.5 (test method and test methodology).

The reverberation chamber test method shall test vehicle electrical/electronic systems by exposing the ESA to statistically homogeneous and isotropic electromagnetic fields created by injection and mechanical stirring.

The reverberation chamber test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11 and, unless otherwise specified, using a test setup with ground plane; TEM cells shall follow Appendix 1 typical dimensions (upper frequency 200 MHz: cell form factor W:b 1.69, L/W 0.66, plate separation b 56 cm, septum S 70 cm; or form factor 1.00, L/W 1, b 60 cm, S 50 cm); for ESAs in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the absorber chamber test of Appendix 2 shall be performed according to ISO 11452-2.
